Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Nexus platform licensing, billing, and architecture.

Can I customize colors, fonts, and dark mode themes?

Yes! Nexus is built with pure Tailwind CSS. You can easily adjust the brand color palette, fonts, spacing scales, or dark mode behavior inside tailwind.config.js in seconds.

Is Nexus compatible with modern backend frameworks like Laravel, Django, Next.js, or Rails?

Absolutely. Since Nexus uses clean semantic HTML5 and standard ES6 vanilla JavaScript with no heavy front-end framework lock-in, you can drop the templates into any Blade, Jinja, React, Vue, or Rails view with zero friction.

How does Dark Mode persistence work?

The theme controller (theme.js) checks localStorage for user preference or falls back to system color scheme (prefers-color-scheme). It applies the class to <html> synchronously in the <head> to prevent any flash of unstyled content.
